name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Putin Floats Chance of Peace Agreement to End War With Ukraine
changes.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin is saying there is a chance of a peace agreement to end the war in Ukraine. However, he said, the conflict must be resolved by the countries involved and not by leaders from other nations. NBC’s Richard Engel reports for TODAY.

changes.title: Rival Ukrainian Intelligence Units Open Fire Against Each Other in Kyiv
changes.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky described the shootout on the streets of the Ukrainian capital as an “absolutely shameful event” and ordered an investigation.

changes.title: For Russia and Ukraine, an Escalating Spiral With No End in Sight
changes.summary: Each side is using missiles and drones to try to pound the other into giving up, breeding ceaseless human suffering. But there is no sign that either country’s determination will weaken.

changes.title: Putin Pledges Increased Strikes in Ukraine and Support for Iran
changes.summary: The Russian president promised continued retaliation against the Ukrainians and “full solidarity” with Iran.

changes.title: Attacks in Black Sea Threaten to Strangle Global Grain Supply
changes.summary: Strikes on ports and vessels by both Russia and Ukraine have left farmers facing ruin and could cause another worldwide food shock.

changes.title: Germany blames Russia for attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport
changes.summary: Moscow has been widely accused by Western officials of running a campaign of sabotage and disruption across Europe with the aim of undermining support for Ukraine and destabilizing European nations.

changes.title: Russia pounds Kyiv with aerial strikes, killing at least 12 people in 6th straight day of attacks
changes.summary: The latest attack struck civilian infrastructure and residential buildings in several districts of Kyiv, authorities said, with eight people killed in the city itself and four others in the surrounding region.

changes.title: Send your questions for Richard Engel on Ukraine and more
changes.summary: Richard Engel is back in Ukraine to report on its intensifying war with Russia, with a strike this weekend on a warehouse west of Kyiv becoming its deadliest attack this year — more than 38 people were killed.

changes.title: A Factory in Rural Ireland Is at the Center of a Dispute Over Russia
changes.summary: Alumina processed at a refinery in County Limerick may be feeding Russia’s war in Ukraine, an investigation suggested. There is little agreement on what to do about it.

changes.title: Bessent reportedly tells Russia no economic relief until Ukraine war ends as Europe snubs Moscow at G20
changes.summary: The meeting underscored Washington's willingness to reopen diplomatic talks with Moscow, as Europe intends to isolate the nation while the war continues.
